posts.author: NyanChu
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I'm currently working on a small personal project in RPG Maker MV (non-commercial, fan-based), and I would love to include Flowey from *Undertale*.
I'm looking for someone who could help me by creating a sprite of Flowey, compatible with RPG Maker MV — ideally a character sprite (charset), or even a simple battler. I don’t need complex animations, just something that fits the MV style.
Unfortunately, I’m not good at pixel art myself, so I’d really appreciate any help.
Thank you so much in advance!
(sorry for my bad english i'm french)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: Whether or not your game is fan-based and free doesn't matter. Creating a sprite of a copyrighted character and sharing it publicly is still illegal, so I think you're going to have bad luck getting one here I'm afraid.

posts.body:

Toby Fox is fine with Undertale fan works as long as you don't include tracks from the OST or make money from them:

posts.author: NyanChu
posts.body: But it's only for personal work, I'll never publish it.

posts.author: Trihan
posts.body:
NyanChu said:
Mais ce n’est que pour un travail personnel, je ne le publierai jamais.
Click to expand...
Notwithstanding that as I just said Toby Fox is fine with stuff like this, as a general rule it's still illegal even if it's for personal use only and you'll never publish it. There's a misconception that copyright only applies if you're putting your work out for public consumption, but that's not the case.
